name: view-last
description: /view opens Claude's last response in your editor, in a separate window, so you can read it any time

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Program that opens the reply, such as notepad, code, or subl. Leave empty to use the platform default (Notepad on Windows, the default text editor on macOS, xdg-open on Linux). Use a program that opens its own window: a terminal editor such as vim has no terminal to run in.

count.title: Default count
count.description: How many replies /view and its hotkey open when you give no number. Defaults to 1 (the latest reply).

order.title: Order
order.description: Order of replies when several are opened: oldest-first puts the latest reply at the bottom, newest-first puts it at the top.
